aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The overall placements included around 1170 offers which is about 85-90 percent students placed and the highest package was 1.2 crore [per annum] from electronics department, and the lowest was 3.3 LPA from many departments.'
Reviewer describes choosing NIT Rourkela CSE over a private university, citing 'the knowledge about future prospects I get here will always be unmatched by any private university.'

'My department's placements aren't that great because most of them chose further studies in this college only or in foreign universities. So in life science, highest 7 LPA, lowest 3.5 LPA in 2023-24, and there were only 3 offers, and these are generally from coaching institutes for teaching.'

'Many companies visit NIT Rourkela to hire MTech students. Placement scenarios of School of Management, NIT Rourkela is increasing day by day.' Note: this directly conflicts with a separate, more negative School of Management placement review found on Shiksha (see below) — both preserved independently.
'All the possible facilities and infrastructure are available for MTech course in School of Management NIT Rourkela. It has great sports facilities and large swimming pool as well.'
'Teachers are very much enthusiastic and knowledgeable. They always clear each doubt. They are always available during class hours. The course curriculum is well-planned.'
'NIT Rourkela has the in-campus hostel facilities. Meals are mostly good and tasty. Rooms are air conditioned with ventilation, markets are near to the campus.'

'There are no almirahs in the hostel and also the internet speed is decent [but] the connectivity for NIT Rourkela is not so good, and the power cuts are very frequent and there is also no generator available for this.'

'The curriculum is not up to date. The college is only focusing on theory but not on the skills for the students, and therefore students have to work by their own to develop such skills which are required for the placements.'

'The mess food is very decent and some lecture rooms are also not well maintained as there are issues of the echo of the voice of professor in the lecture halls.' (Mixed descriptive statement combining a neutral mess assessment with a facilities complaint; recorded as neutral for the mess-specific portion since 'very decent' is a lukewarm, non-strongly-valenced descriptor.)
'In year 2024-25 the number of companies that visited the campus is around 330 and the total job offers offered is about 1200.'

'The highest package in the EC branch is about 1.2 crore per annum and the average package for the EC branch is around 13 to 14 lakhs. Profile of jobs are core electronics, VLSI and semiconductor roles, systems and embedded development, software engineering, IT services, consulting and analytics. The percentage of students getting placed is in the range of 90 to 99% for ECE branch.' Recruiters named: Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Wipro, Deloitte, Tata, Vedanta.
'There are some subjects that are not related to the branch but we have to study them for grades, so I think those subjects should be removed. The subjects should be related to the branch.'

'The quality of infrastructure in this college is not so good as this college [was] made in the 1960s, but new buildings are also under construction, and the amenities that the campus provides include all sports access and an Olympic-level pool.'
'Inside the campus there are lots of shops, restaurants, stalls etc, so students don't have to go outside the campus to buy anything.'

'The placements of NIT Rourkela is good. The average placement of the college is around 6-7 LPA. Mostly all the students got placed. Last year, the highest package was 29 LPA which is offered by Amazon. Many core and analytical companies visit every year. Around 90-100% of the students got placed.'

'The infrastructure of NIT Rourkela is very good. It is the second largest college in India (after IIT Kharagpur). The Wi-Fi facilities are available in most of the departments. About food, if you are coming from another place, you may not like the food. Many new hostels like Satish Dhawan are very neat and clean, whereas other older hostels are not much clean.'

'NIT Rourkela School of Management is one of the worst departments of the National Institute of Technology Rourkela with no placement assistance from its core placement committee.' Note: this directly conflicts with a separate, more positive School of Management placement review found on CollegeDekho (see above) — both preserved independently rather than reconciled.

Batch of 2022 reviewer: 'Core branches get very good placements here. Placements in lower branches are quite low. More than 80% of the students get placed every year.' Companies named: Microsoft, Tata Steel, Mu Sigma, Adobe, Myntra, Qualcomm, Bajaj.

'The infrastructure is amazing. The hostels are also good. The mess facilities are also decent. The food served is up to the quality. The medical facility is also available 24/7 provided with certified doctors and nurses. The sports culture is given great importance too.'

'The curriculum is good although it is a little outdated. So the faculty members and administration should look over it again and update it. The teaching is also good. Some teachers are highly talented and encourage students to understand the subject with core understanding.'

'Mechanical engineering remains one of the most interesting and wonderful courses the college has to offer. Fests play a huge part in NIT Rourkela, it brings all the students together as one. Extra-curricular activities are also a very important factor of the institute, with numerous clubs and sports teams.' (Note: this sentence references mechanical engineering despite the reviewer's own course being listed as Mining Engineering — recorded at college scope since the campus-life claim itself is general, not branch-specific.)

review_items.review_title: Review of National Institute of Technology, Rourkela

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. They provide the Wi-Fi, which is very useful for networking. In labs, provide the AC and projector. Classrooms are good, and we provide the AC and projector for display. The library is good, and it provides AC and a projector.'

review_items.review_title: How are the facilities in hostels at NIT Rourkela?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'You got a mess, but food is not good except breakfast and Sunday lunch. You have dhobis to wash your clothes, they will collect from your room, but you have to pay for that, it's not free. Also, never give expensive clothes, they will ruin it. I had that experience.'

review_items.review_title: NIT Rourkela: Hostels, Faculty, and Campus Placements Review

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'The institute has good ranking in all India National Institute Ranking frameworks... The academics at the institute are very good with updated curriculum according to the recommendations of National Educational Policy, 2020. The labs also contain good instruments and chemicals.'

'The infrastructure of the institute is very good with well-equipped classrooms. The rooms have projectors and air conditioners as well. There is also a library with about 80,000 books... There is a health center in the campus for medical purposes. The sports facilities in the campus are also very good with good equipment for every sport.'

'NIT Rourkela offers residential facilities for every student. There are about 11 hostels for boys, girls, and married students as well. The hostel fee is about Rs. 5,000 per semester and mess fee is about Rs. 4,000 per month.' Descriptive/factual rather than clearly valenced.

'The campus life is very good with the campus area being 650 acres. There are many clubs and they are very good. There are about 80 clubs under 4 societies, namely Technical Society, Games & Sports Society...' (list truncated in source).
